title: Function OS Symbolic Function Candidate Reference Implementation — Scope & Non-Goal Contract
status: CANDIDATE — NOT FROZEN, NOT FINAL, NOT PROVEN

function_types: Pure symbolic functions with explicit pre/postconditions
Deterministic computation over known input domains
Functions expressible in the safe expression DSL subset
representations: JSON FunctionSpec with explicit fields per N1 schema
Safe expression language (no eval, no shell, no network, no filesystem)
equivalence: Identity comparison (same spec + same inputs = same output)

explicitly_excluded: Weight-space functions (LoRA, merged checkpoints, model soups, task vectors)
Arbitrary side effects (I/O, network, shell, filesystem)
Automatic FunctionSpec discovery from code or weights
Backward compatibility with 120 or earlier Function OS sketches

failure_semantics.spec_failure: Strict parse failure with structured error — unknown fields, missing required fields, type mismatches
failure_semantics.compilation_failure: Returns UNSUPPORTED for non-symbolic functions, COMPILE_ERROR for malformed specs
failure_semantics.precondition_failure: Returns VIOLATION with which condition failed and actual vs expected values
failure_semantics.postcondition_failure: Returns VIOLATION with which condition failed — artifact is NOT registered
failure_semantics.hash_mismatch: Returns INTEGRITY_FAILURE — artifact is NOT loaded or executed
failure_semantics.version_conflict: Returns VERSION_CONFLICT — explicit human intervention required
failure_semantics.dependency_missing: Returns MISSING_DEPENDENCY with list of missing dependencies

version_semantics.artifact_version: Semver-like, tied to spec_version + compiler version
version_semantics.content_hash: SHA-256 of canonical JSON — used for integrity verification
version_semantics.supersedes: Pointer to previous registry revision — stored, never deleted

internal_only: Registry storage format (filesystem-json only for v0.1)

implementation_constraints.registry_storage: Local filesystem JSON store only (no database, no network)
implementation_constraints.expression_subset: Arithmetic, comparison, boolean logic, conditional (if-then-else) only
implementation_constraints.source_of_truth: FunctionSpec JSON file → Compiler → Artifact → Registry
implementation_constraints.immutable_history: Registry append-only, no deletion of historical revisions
